blocks.text: Professional Office Junk Removal Company for Workspaces of Every Size

c: An office accumulates more than anyone budgets time for. Rows of desks and task chairs, cubicle partitions bolted together a decade ago, filing cabinets heavy with paper, boardroom tables that barely fit through the door they came in, plus a storage room of retired monitors, printers, and cables nobody ever threw out. When the lease ends, the team goes hybrid, or the company relocates, all of it has to leave — usually on a hard date written into a commercial lease.

That’s the job our office cleanout crews are built for. We dismantle workstations, break down cubicle systems, haul furniture and equipment, and separate what can be donated, resold, or recycled where possible from what can’t.

blocks.text: Fast Commercial Junk Removal Before Your Lease Deadline Hits

c: Commercial leases don’t negotiate. Miss the handover date and you’re paying holdover rent, forfeiting deposits, or delaying the next tenant’s fit-out — costs that dwarf the price of professional help. {{fact:scheduling}}

Our trucks leave with everything the business isn’t taking: desks, chairs, cubicle panels, filing cabinets, shelving, reception furniture, kitchenette appliances, whiteboards, and the e-waste graveyard in the server closet. Furniture in good condition is channelled to charities, nonprofits, and startups that can use it; metals, electronics, and cardboard head to recyclers; and only true waste is disposed of. Your handover checklist gets shorter, and very little of your office ends up in a landfill.
Commercial cleanout pricing is volume-based and confirmed in writing — a number your accountant sees before our crew does the work.
Call us now at +1 647 922 5865 or book online at LiveJunkFree.ca.

blocks.text: Full-Service Office Furniture Removal – Cubicles, Desks & Equipment Haul Away

c: There’s a reason office clearances defeat DIY attempts: commercial furniture is engineered to be assembled once and never moved. Cubicle systems are bolted, wired, and interlocked. L-shaped desks won’t clear standard doorways in one piece. Loaded lateral filing cabinets can exceed a few hundred pounds each.

Live Junk Free has cleared spaces from single private offices and dental suites to full corporate floors, coworking buildouts, call centres, and multi-tenant buildings being repositioned by their landlords. Whatever triggered the clearance — relocation, downsizing to hybrid, a closure, a renovation, or a lease surrender — we scale the operation to your square footage and your calendar.

Building logistics are handled on our side of the table. {{fact:insuranceDocs}}. Inside the suite, workstations are dismantled systematically and staged for efficient loading, so the job wraps in hours, not days.

items: Systematic teardown – Cubicles, workstations, and modular furniture dismantled and removed to the bare floor
Responsible redistribution – Usable furniture donated or rehomed, e-waste and metals recycled where possible, and the suite left for handover

blocks.text: Our Commercial Office Clearance Process from Walkthrough to Handover

items: Every clearance starts with a site walkthrough or a photo/video survey, from which we produce a scope: what’s leaving, what stays for the landlord, what needs dismantling, and what the building requires for access. On the day, crews work zone by zone — open floor first, then private offices, meeting rooms, storage, and kitchenette — staging items at the freight elevator for continuous truck loading.
The job closes with a floor plate and a joint walkthrough (or timestamped photos for remote decision-makers), giving you documented proof the suite met its surrender condition.

c: From cubicle farms and packed file rooms to bare floor plates — see how GTA businesses handed back their spaces on time and in surrender condition.

items.q: 1) Can you clear our office outside business hours?
a: {{fact:scheduling}} Many clients have their team work normally on Friday and return Monday to an empty suite. We coordinate security access, alarm procedures, and building quiet-hour rules directly with property management..

items.q: 2) Do you dismantle cubicles and modular workstations?
a: We do, and it’s a core part of the service. Our crews carry the tools to unbolt, de-wire, and break down cubicle systems, benching setups, and modular desks, then remove the components efficiently. Panels and parts in good condition are offered for reuse before recycling.

items.q: 3) What happens to our old computers, monitors, and IT equipment?
a: All electronics go to e-waste recyclers for proper processing. If your equipment contains sensitive data, we recommend your IT team wipe or remove drives beforehand; we can also segregate data-bearing devices so they’re handled exactly as your policy requires.
Absolutely. {{fact:insuranceDocs}}. Property managers deal with us directly, so nothing lands on your plate but the final sign-off.

items.q: 5) How is an office cleanout priced?
a: By volume — the truck space your items occupy — not by the hour. After a walkthrough or photo survey you receive one written, figure covering labour, dismantling, hauling, recycling. {{fact:changedScope}}.
